name: Mama Bear Puzzle
author: Sebastian Mihai
description_short: A classic 15 puzzle game with sliding tiles on a four by four grid
description_long: Mama Bear Puzzle is a direct implementation of the classic 15 puzzle game for the Nintendo GameCube. It features a four by four sliding tile area where one tile is missing. The goal is to restore a configuration where all tiles are in order. Use the d-pad to slide tiles and the Start button to reset the puzzle.
